title: A sex-specific ST-depression interaction failed to improve cross-hospital coronary prediction
abstract: A fixed female-by-exercise-ST-depression interaction did not improve angiographic CAD prediction: Hungarian target Brier loss increased from 0.153235 to 0.156411 after Cleveland training; joint-refit 95% interval for improvement [-0.012176, 0.001956]. Source fivefold cross-validation also worsened slightly. This is an existing-public-data negative result in historical referral cohorts, not evidence against all sex-specific exercise ECG interpretation. Independent hospital validation was performed, but these public cohorts were historically reused and not lifetime untouched. Author self-checks and isolated clean reruns are not independent peer review.
